test_is_point_in_triangle: test is_point_in_triangle to check if a 3D point lies within a triangle defined by three vertices
test_random_triangle_point: test random_triangle_point to sample uniformly distributed random points inside a 3D triangle
test_point_in_triangle_corners: test is_point_in_triangle with corner vertices to verify boundary inclusion returns True
test_point_in_triangle_outside: test is_point_in_triangle with points outside the triangle plane to verify they return False
test_random_triangle_point_uniformity: test random_triangle_point centroid distribution to verify uniform sampling across a triangle
